metadata.methods_description: EEG was recorded at 250 Hz from 74 passive Ag/AgCl Easycap electrodes, referenced to the mastoids, simultaneously with a MEGIN TRIUX MEG system, and BCI2000 was used for acquisition and feedback. Each trial had a 1 s inter-stimulus interval followed by a 5 s target presentation, with cursor feedback from 3 to 6 s. Participants performed right-hand motor imagery for the up target and rested for the down target, with 6 runs of up to 32 trials per session.
